blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Twenty-five times thirteen times four.
Twenty-five and four make one hundred, so let's put them together. The commutative property lets us swap the thirteen and the four.
The associative property lets us group the twenty-five with the four.
Twenty-five times four is one hundred.
One hundred times thirteen is one thousand three hundred.
So the answer is one thousand three hundred.
Watch out for these traps. If you add twenty-five and four, you get three hundred seventy-seven. If you add the thirteen at the end, you get one hundred thirteen.
